function.name: log_promise_to_pay
function.description: Logs a Promise-to-Pay (PTP) date and amount when a customer agrees to pay on a specific date in the future.

customer_id.description: The unique identifier of the customer. Use 'CUST_9988' for Rahul Sharma.

ptp_date.description: The date the customer has promised to pay, formatted as YYYY-MM-DD. Must be within 3 days.

ptp_amount.description: The amount the customer has promised to pay. Defaults to 8499.00.
